payload.note: One-site single-well checkpoint: every one-site conditional fiber of the residual-square BT action on a q-regular graph with q<16 has exactly one critical point, its global minimum. For the four-dimensional q=8 lattice, exact elimination gives curvature greater than 13 at that minimum. An exact periodic 4^4 fixture has curvature -57 away from the minimum, so global one-site convexity and direct convex local-to-global imports are obstructed even though conditional double wells are ruled out. A background-uniform one-site Poincare bound, inter-site influence control, Witten coercivity, interacting H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open. The next gate is the one-dimensional Muckenhoupt/Hardy constant for the constrained exponential-quartic fiber family.
